title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About Ironstone Ironstone is an AI product startup in Maslak, İstanbul. We build consumer apps for learning, wellbeing and everyday utility, and we're now building our main project: a new SaaS platform for businesses. We're hiring our first team, so the people who join now shape what we build and how we build it. What we’re building We’re building an AI-first platform that helps businesses turn what they already have into finished, high-quality work in minutes instead of weeks. Under the hood it runs on a pipeline of AI models, automated quality checks and media processing. The interesting problems are in that pipeline: orchestrating models at scale, judging AI output automatically, and making the results reliable enough for businesses to use as-is. We don’t talk about the specifics publicly yet; we will on the intro call. About the role You’ll be engineer number one and our technical lead, working directly with the founder. This is a hands-on role: you’ll write code and ship features every day, building the architecture, data model, web app, AI pipelines and AWS infrastructure yourself. Alongside the building, you’ll play a leading role in architecture and tool planning, including which vendors and services we use, set the engineering standards the team builds on, and manage the technical side of the project day to day. What you’ll do Build the web app with Next.js (App Router), React and TypeScript, using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. Design the data model and APIs on Supabase (Postgres, Auth, row-level security, Realtime) with Drizzle. Build durable background workflows on AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, SQS) that orchestrate AI models, with retries, queues and webhooks done properly. Integrate language, image and video models behind a clean provider layer, so we can switch models without touching the product. Build automated quality gates that score generated images and video before users see them. Build video and image finishing (rendering, captions, resizing) and delivery through S3 and CloudFront. Implement usage-based billing on an auditable, append-only credit ledger. Set up CI/CD, preview environments, infrastructure as code (AWS CDK), monitoring (Sentry) and product analytics (PostHog). Plan the architecture and tooling together with the founder, and document the decisions so the team can move fast. Manage the project’s technical work: plan the sprints, set priorities, review code and keep delivery on track. What we look for 3+ years building production web applications, including owning the architecture of at least one production system built on background jobs or workflows. Strong TypeScript, React and Next.js. Solid Postgres and API design: schemas, migrations, auth and access control. Solid knowledge of, and hands-on experience with, AWS, Google Cloud or another major cloud platform. Comfortable debugging distributed systems: a stuck workflow, a failed webhook, a queue that backs up. You’ve shipped AI features to real users and know where they break. You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) daily and can show how they make you faster without making your code worse. You’ve led technical projects, reviewed other people’s code or mentored engineers as part of your job. Good written and spoken English. Nice to have Supabase, AWS Step Functions or other workflow engines. Programmatic video and image processing (FFmpeg, Remotion, HyperFrames or similar). Generative image or video models in production, or computer-vision checks on generated media. LLM evaluation and prompt engineering. MCP servers, OAuth 2.1 or building integrations with AI assistants. Payments and subscriptions (Paddle, Stripe). What we offer A new MacBook Claude subscription Meal card Revenue-linked bonus Real ownership

title: Backend Developer
description: Dijital Güvenlik Sektöründe Kariyer Fırsatı! Sen de dijital güvenlik sektöründe kariyer yapmak ve parlak bir geleceğe adım atmak ister misin? ArkSigner, e-imza ve Kimlik Doğrulama çözümleriyle teknoloji sektöründe lider konumda olan dinamik bir şirkettir. 2015 yılında başlayan yolculuğumuz bugün Türkiye’nin en büyük bankaları, holdingleri, finans kuruluşları ve kamu kurumlarıyla devam ediyor. Yazılım ve donanım ürünlerimizle dijital güvenlik alanında yeni standartlar belirlemeyi amaçlıyoruz. Tüm mevzuatlara uygun, yerli imkanlarla geliştirilmiş elektronik imza ve kimlik doğrulama çözümlerimizle Türkiye’de ve globalde güvenliği yeniden tanımlıyoruz. Buradan hareketle şirketimizin Ankara ofisinde görevlendirilmek üzere çalışma arkadaşımızı ekibimize katılmaya davet ediyoruz! Aranan Nitelikler: Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, .NET teknolojileriyle yazılım geliştirme konusunda 3-4 yıl deneyimli, C# ile hem .NET Framework 4.7.2 hem de .NET Core 6.0 / 8.0 / 9.0 sürümlerinde uygulama geliştirmiş, MSSQL veritabanı, LINQ to Entity ve Entity Framework konularında deneyimli, REST API ve SOAP servisleri geliştirme ve entegrasyonu konularında bilgi sahibi, MVC mimarisi ile çalışmış, JavaScript ve jQuery konularında tecrübeli, SOLID prensipleri ve Nesne Yönelimli Programlama (OOP) konularına hakim, Design patterns (tasarım desenleri) konusunda uygulama tecrübesi olan, RabbitMQ ve Redis ile mesajlaşma ve önbellekleme sistemlerinde çalışmış, Windows Services geliştirme ve yönetimi konularında deneyim sahibi.

title: Blockchain Backend Engineer
description: Design the future architecture of one of Europe's most innovative banking networks while empowering engineers to do their best work. Role Summary We are looking for a Blockchain Java Backend Engineer to help build the next generation of digital asset, tokenization, and distributed financial infrastructure capabilities within ING. You will design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, integration layers, event-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms that support emerging digital asset and distributed ledger initiatives. While prior blockchain experience is welcome, it is not required. We are primarily looking for strong software engineers who are passionate about building resilient, secure, and high-performing distributed systems and are interested in expanding into the blockchain and digital assets domain. Work Model At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit—it's part of how we work. Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote. We also provide additional flexibility throughout August with remote working opportunities, allowing colleagues to remain productive while staying connected with their teams. As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations and contribute to solutions used across the bank. About the Team You will join an international technology organization where ownership, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engineering excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our teams design and deliver critical technology platforms that support ING's digital transformation journey. We believe scalable architectures, strong engineering practices, automation, and continuous learning are essential for delivering reliable solutions at scale. communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills Experience working in Agile organizations Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline Fluent English (C1 or above) Technical Skills Strong experience with Java (preferred), Kotlin, Spring Boot REST APIs and microservices Experience with Event-driven architectures, Kafka, RabbitMQ (or similar messaging technologies) SQL and NoSQL databases Docker, Kubernetes CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows Good understanding of Distributed systems System integration API design Scalability patterns Roles & Responsibilities Engineering & Platform Development Design, build, and operate scalable backend services, APIs, and cloud-native microservices Develop integration solutions between banking systems and digital asset platforms Build secure, resilient, and highly available services supporting financial transactions Contribute to architecture decisions covering scalability, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability Digital Assets & Distributed Systems Support distributed financial platforms and digital asset initiatives Contribute to tokenization, blockchain, settlement, custody, and servicing capabilities Learn and apply distributed ledger technologies where appropriate Collaborate with blockchain engineers and architects Engineering Excellence Build automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines Apply clean code and software craftsmanship principles Improve observability, monitoring, logging, and operational resilience Support production environments, incident resolution, and reusable platform capabilities Security & Compliance Apply security-by-design principles and secure coding standards Collaborate with security, risk, and compliance teams Ensure regulatory and internal control requirements are addressed throughout delivery Collaboration Work in Agile squads with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, SREs, and Security Specialists Collaborate with global ING engineering teams Contribute to engineering communities, demos, knowledge sharing, and innovation initiatives Equal Opportunity Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. What We Offer at ING Hubs Türkiye At ING Hubs Türkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. Be Yourself, Be an ING'er Welcome Leave: Enjoy 14 days of welcome leave, even in your first year Self-driven career opportunities Challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities Flexible hybrid working model Remote working opportunities throughout August Training budget and Udemy partnership Global mobility and international career opportunities Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family Private Pension Plan Meal Card Transportation Allowance MultiSport Membership English Language Development Support Innovation culture powered by PACE methodology Regular communication activities and celebrations About ING With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.
